why_ai: Day-of execution on site and emotional client management keep a trusted human planner in charge.
why_clarity: Timelines and checklists exist, but each event differs and client satisfaction is partly taste.
why_digital: The deliverable is an in-person event built from local venues and vendors.

why_ai: Rigging and load calculations carry safety accountability and rely on venue-specific technical knowledge.
why_clarity: Plots, riders and load calculations are exact engineering documents tested at load-in on fixed dates.
why_digital: Designs are drafted on screen but start from venues and become physical rigs.

why_ai: Budget-to-actual and invoice matching follow standardizable patterns that accounting software absorbs.
why_clarity: Budgets, vendor invoices and client bills reconcile to exact amounts after each change.
why_digital: Spreadsheets, invoices and accounting records are reconciled entirely on screen.

why_ai: Longitudinal booking data across most US weddings is a proprietary asset AI cannot recreate.
why_clarity: Annual spend studies follow established survey and data methods on a fixed cycle.
why_digital: Marketplace booking and budget data analyzed and published as digital research.

why_ai: On-site execution and multi-stakeholder politics persist, though RFPs and reporting automate.
why_clarity: RFP and procurement templates structure the work, but ROI and stakeholder success stay contested.
why_digital: Sourcing and registration are online, but the conference itself happens in person.

why_ai: Spend consolidation and savings reporting are analytics AI-native software can produce from client data.
why_clarity: Recurring spend consolidation is exact, though savings definitions are negotiated with procurement.
why_digital: Meetings spend and supplier data in, savings and compliance reports out.

why_ai: Volunteer-run, multilingual community events depend on local relationships and physical presence.
why_clarity: Each event has unique community needs and success is judged informally.
why_digital: Organized through flyers, Facebook groups and neighbours, delivered in person locally.

why_ai: Publicly funded impact studies need an accountable local authority, though drafting automates.
why_clarity: Economic impact multipliers are contested and the claimed impact is never verified.
why_digital: Booking pace and survey data in, published studies out, bought through public procurement.

why_ai: The credential's authority is the product, and legally defensible exams need an accountable body.
why_clarity: Psychometric practice analysis and item statistics are codified, recurring and checkable.
why_digital: Exams and standards are digital, though testing is often proctored at centres.

why_ai: Attribution studies on client-owned pipeline data are analytics work that AI tools are absorbing.
why_clarity: Event ROI is chronically hard to define and attribution claims cannot be checked quickly.
why_digital: Client pipeline and attendee data in, digital attribution studies out.

why_ai: Crowd plans required by municipalities and insurers are examined after incidents; accountable experts sign.
why_clarity: Success means no incident, which is rare and only examined after something goes wrong.
why_digital: Plans are written documents, but start from physical venues and crowds.

why_ai: Sourcing and contract data across most corporate meetings is a proprietary asset, analyzed by software.
why_clarity: Pace and rate benchmarks come from continuous, structured platform records.
why_digital: Platform transaction data in, published benchmarks out.

why_ai: Long-running member surveys carry association authority, but report production is easily automated.
why_clarity: Annual surveys follow set methods, though economic significance figures go unchecked.
why_digital: Survey data in, published research out, funded by membership and sponsorship.

why_ai: Multi-stage outdoor productions with hundreds of crew and safety permits happen physically on site.
why_clarity: Scheduling is optimizable, but creative and safety calls vary with each complex production.
why_digital: Stages, crews and vendors on a field, coordinated by spreadsheets and radio.

why_ai: Group pricing and displacement analysis are forecasting models run by revenue software.
why_clarity: Codified revenue science on recurring quotes, checked against realized transient demand later.
why_digital: Inquiry, quote and demand data in, pricing models out.

why_ai: The virtual half automates readily; the in-person half still needs on-site production.
why_clarity: Live engagement analytics give fast feedback, but the dual-audience workflow is improvised.
why_digital: Half the audience gets a stream, half a physical venue.

why_ai: Human-collected meeting records nobody discloses form a durable data moat, though collection is routine.
why_clarity: Each meeting record is a structured fact collected repeatedly across thousands of properties.
why_digital: Starts from reader boards and property contacts, delivered as a subscription database.

why_ai: Galas and auctions rely on donor relationships and in-person execution.
why_clarity: Dollars raised is a clear, agreed metric visible on the night.
why_digital: Donations process online, but the gala is a physical in-person event.

why_ai: Programme assessments and roadmaps are analysis and writing that AI drafts well.
why_clarity: Policy and supplier strategy follow consulting frameworks; whether savings materialize appears later.
why_digital: Programme data in, written assessment out, sold through principal relationships.

why_ai: Templated vendor communication and confirmation sequences are rule-based work agents absorb.
why_clarity: Confirmations and logistics details recur for every event and are checked by reply.
why_digital: Email and phone coordination with local vendors for a physical event.

why_ai: Associates' relationships and negotiated rate knowledge matter, though AI sourcing tools compete.
why_clarity: Rates and concessions are concrete numbers, negotiated differently each placement.
why_digital: Sourcing and contracting run remotely, with relationships and site visits still common.

why_ai: Emotionally charged, referral-driven work where the planner relationship and day-of presence are the product.
why_clarity: Success is the couple's vision and feelings, judged once with no second attempt.
why_digital: Local vendors and venues, delivered in person, sold by referral.
